description: Toleration represents a pod's toleration for a node's taint.

effect.description: Required. The effect of the toleration.

key.description: Key is the taint key that the toleration applies to.

operator.description: Operator represents a key's relationship to the value.

tolerationSeconds.description: TolerationSeconds represents the period of time the toleration (which must be of effect NoExecute, otherwise this field is ignored) tolerates the taint.

value.description: Value is the taint value that the toleration matches.
